# #2255: Patch: the account screen shows this ranked season's record beside the rank
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The account screen shows a player's rank in the current ranked season, plus one win–loss–draw record covering every game they have ever played. It never shows how they are doing this season, even though the server already sends that. Once this is built, the rank block also reads, for example, “This season (ranked): 14–9–1”, so a player can see their climb at a glance.

## Why

- `GET /api/ranked` already answers `record` (games, wins, losses, draws) for the caller's current season (`crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs:718`, filled at `:742-747`), and the client types it (`apps/web/src/net/api.ts:1289`).
- No client code reads it: `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx:367-385` shows only `profile.record`, the all-time count from `/api/profile`, and the play lobby (`routes/play.tsx`) shows only the crest and its caption.

## Proposal

- In the account screen's rank block, show the season's W–L–D from `getOwnRank`'s `record` under a clear label (“This season (ranked)”), and keep the all-time Record section as it is. Leave the line out while the season has 0 games.
- Optionally add the same one line under the crest in the play lobby.
- Client only; the strings go through `t()` with zh-CN entries.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx`, `account.test.tsx` (optionally `routes/play.tsx`)
- `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`
- SPEC §9.12

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A ranked answer of 14 wins, 9 losses and 1 draw shows “14–9–1” under the season label (vitest).
- [ ] With 0 season games the line is absent, and the all-time record is unchanged.
- [ ] A failed ranked read shows exactly what it shows today.

## Size and risks

Small, 2 to 3 files. Risk: two records side by side could confuse a player, so each label must say which record it is.

---
